scripts.setup:backend: cd smart-attendance/backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:admin && npm run setup:live && npm run setup:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:live
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run dev:backend
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,ADMIN,LIVE" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:live"
